import collections, json, pathlib, re, subprocess
turn="independent_quadratic_parent_audit_20260914_139"
dest=pathlib.Path("research/results")/turn
html=pathlib.Path("notebook.html").read_text()
old=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:notebook.html"],text=True)
marker="<!-- Append new dated mathematical entries here, preserving earlier entries. -->"
start='<article class="research-entry"'
entry_id="entry-2026-09-14-combined-rank-two-source-exclusion"
entry_start=start+' id="'+entry_id+'">'
assert old[old.index(start):old.index(marker)]==html[html.index(start):html.index(entry_start)]
entry=html[html.index(entry_start):html.index(marker)]
ids=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"',html))
links=re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"',entry)
assert all(ids[a]==1 for a in links+[entry_id])
assert html.count("<!-- TIMING "+turn+" -->")==1
counts=collections.Counter()
source_images=0
parameters=[]
summary=None
with (dest/"combined-source-checks.jsonl").open() as f:
    for line in f:
        item=json.loads(line)
        counts[item["record"]]+=1
        if "passed" in item:
            assert item["passed"] is True
        if item["record"]=="NS_certificate" and "source_axiom" in item:
            source_images+=1
        if item["record"]=="finite_parameters":
            parameters.append({"ell":item["ell"],"all_sufficient_conditions":
                item["space_and_image_conditions"] and item["old_degree_condition"]})
        if item["record"]=="summary":
            summary=item
assert counts["NS_certificate"]==42 and source_images==41
assert counts["conditional_model"]==448
assert counts["quotient_count"]==3 and counts["occupation_count"]==1
assert counts["cube_packing"]==2 and counts["unweighted_countermodel"]==1
assert parameters==[{"ell":64,"all_sufficient_conditions":False},
                    {"ell":128,"all_sufficient_conditions":True},
                    {"ell":256,"all_sufficient_conditions":True}]
assert summary["NS_certificates"]==42
result={"session":turn,"record_counts":dict(counts),"weighted_source_images":source_images,
        "finite_parameters":parameters,"previous_research_record_unchanged":True,
        "new_entry_internal_links_checked":len(links),"unique_timing_placeholder":True,
        "passed":True}
with (dest/"check-metadata.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
